title: Package Manager Essentials
description: Learn to use common package managers for different programming ecosystems

steps.title: Package Management Overview
steps.content:
Package managers are essential tools that help you:

- Install software and libraries
- Manage dependencies
- Update packages
- Remove packages
- Track versions

Common package managers:
- npm (Node.js)
- pip (Python)
- gem (Ruby)
- apt/apt-get (Ubuntu/Debian)
- brew (macOS)

steps.title: NPM Fundamentals
steps.content:
Node Package Manager (npm) commands:

- npm init: Create new project
- npm install: Install all dependencies
- npm install package: Install specific package
- npm uninstall package: Remove package
- npm update: Update packages
- npm list: List installed packages

Key concepts:
- package.json: Project manifest
- node_modules: Dependencies directory
- package-lock.json: Lock file

Common flags:
- --save (-S): Save as dependency
- --save-dev (-D): Save as dev dependency
- -g: Install globally

practical_task.description: Create a new npm project and install the 'express' package as a dependency. Type the commands you used.

steps.title: Python Package Management
steps.content:
Managing Python packages with pip:

- pip install package: Install package
- pip uninstall package: Remove package
- pip list: Show installed packages
- pip freeze: Generate requirements.txt
- pip install -r requirements.txt: Install from file

Best practices:
- Use virtual environments (venv)
- Specify versions in requirements.txt
- Use pip-tools for dependency management
- Keep requirements updated

Virtual environments:
- python -m venv env: Create environment
- source env/bin/activate: Activate (Unix)
- env\Scripts\activate: Activate (Windows)

practical_task.description: Create a virtual environment, activate it, and install the 'requests' package. Type 'done' when complete.

steps.title: System Package Management
steps.content:
System-level package managers:

Ubuntu/Debian (apt):
- apt update: Update package list
- apt install package: Install package
- apt remove package: Remove package
- apt upgrade: Upgrade all packages
- apt search term: Search packages

macOS (brew):
- brew install package: Install package
- brew uninstall package: Remove package
- brew update: Update brew
- brew upgrade: Upgrade packages
- brew search term: Search packages

Best practices:
- Keep system updated
- Clean unused packages
- Use official repositories
- Back up before major upgrades

exercises.question: What command initializes a new npm project?
exercises.explanation: npm init creates a new package.json file for your Node.js project.

exercises.question: What command creates a Python virtual environment?
exercises.explanation: python -m venv env creates a new virtual environment named 'env'.

exercises.question: What command updates the package list in Ubuntu/Debian?
exercises.explanation: apt update refreshes the package list to get the latest available versions.

exercises.question: What command installs a package with Homebrew?
exercises.explanation: brew install package_name installs packages on macOS using Homebrew.
